title: Compose Js All Fields Present
description: User request: ensure all fields are present (context: compose/js GraphQL / golden schema). Investigate codebase requirement and implement.
summary: GraphQL-over-HTTP wire bodies now always serialize query, variables (default {}), and operationName (default null) via normalizeGraphqlWirePostBody / graphqlWirePostBodyJson; used by executeGraphql, GqlTransport execute/subscribe, and extended subscribeJson to accept optional operationName. Vitest asserts canonical JSON keys.
